sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Ujjwala Scheme
sources.authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / Oil Marketing Companies
sources.review_note: Reviewed Q1-Q6, Q12-Q19 and Q27-Q31. Eligibility facts are limited to the page wording; answer should direct applicants to the current KYC/guidelines for full conditions.
sources.scope_note: Official site displays copyright and all-rights-reserved notice. Public repo stores metadata, hash and original paraphrased summaries only, not the raw HTML snapshot.

sources.title: PMUY: New Ujjwala 2.0 Connection
sources.authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / Oil Marketing Companies
sources.review_note: Page states applicant must be a woman aged 18+, household has no other OMC LPG connection, and poor-household status is based on deprivation declaration. Page links to current declaration form, whose PDF extraction was image-only and is not included as answer evidence.
sources.scope_note: Official site displays copyright and all-rights-reserved notice. Public repo stores metadata, hash and original paraphrased summaries only, not the raw HTML snapshot.

sources.title: MSME Schemes Booklet, PM Vishwakarma section (2025 edition)
sources.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
sources.review_note: Reviewed printed pages 34-35 (PDF pages 36-37), benefits, application route and the 18 trades. This is a dated 2025 booklet; check current official portal for amendments before advising an application.
sources.scope_note: Do not treat the booklet as proof of current operational availability; dated values are always attributed to the 2025 edition.

sources.title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana: Ministry information note
sources.authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment / Press Information Bureau
sources.review_note: Reviewed pages 1-4 for scheme purpose, stated eligibility/exclusions, benefit and enrolment route. It is ministry public information, not a substitute for current enrolment validation.

sources.title: National Scholarship Portal: Academic Year 2026-27 scheme listing (NMMSS entry)
sources.authority: Ministry of Education / National Scholarship Portal, NIC
sources.review_note: Reviewed current Academic Year 2026-27 NMMSS listing. Student application date is time-sensitive and evidence expires after 2026-10-31; never reuse beyond that date without rechecking NSP.
sources.scope_note: The page is an official live listing, not a full eligibility guideline.

sources.title: PM-KISAN official portal home and scheme summary (snapshot checked 2026-10-31)
sources.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.review_note: Reviewed scheme summary, official exclusion summary, eKYC notice and instruction to use Know Your Status/Kisan eMitra for account-level status. Treat account status as live and refer users to official portal.
sources.scope_note: Official portal display may change; cited snapshot is dated and must be refreshed before deadline/current-status answers.

sources.title: PM-KISAN: Note on Modes and Processes of e-KYC
sources.authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.review_note: Document describes OTP, biometric and face-authentication eKYC methods and their steps. It has no visible publication date in the extracted text and may be older; answer must label it as a portal note and say to verify current availability on PM-KISAN.

sources.title: PMUY Declaration for New Connection (linked from current application page)
sources.authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / Oil Marketing Companies
sources.review_note: The current application page links this form, but the downloaded PDF page is image-only and text extraction returned no readable text. It is excluded from runtime passages until human transcription and visual review are completed.
